V1.verbatim: test out and experiment with new features to see if they work as expected.

V1.verbatim: undertake experiments to evaluate the impact of new features.
V1.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Legitimate Interests', linha 'To improve the WhatsApp Service by developing new features or updating existing features, we:'
V1.por_que: Nomeia 'experiments' em sentido experimental (avaliar impacto de novas features) dentro da política de privacidade vinculante — evidência central para V1 nível 3 e para v1_register.

V1.verbatim: product research and testing (features of) services to help us improve our Services; and
V1.onde: Doc 1, seção 'How We Work With Other Meta Companies', lista de serviços prestados por Meta Companies no Reino Unido e Estados Unidos
V1.por_que: Combina 'research' e 'testing' de features como atividade declarada, reforçando reconhecimento de teste com usuários.

V1.verbatim: generate and validate metrics to understand how and how often our Services are used and how this compares to usage across the Meta Companies, in order to inform and improve product direction and development and forecast future adoption of the service or features.
V1.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Legitimate Interests', linha 'To improve the WhatsApp Service by developing new features or updating existing features'
V1.por_que: Contexto imediato do item 'undertake experiments'; mostra o enquadramento de melhoria de produto em que o experimento é declarado.

V1.verbatim: We are always trying to improve our Services. That means we may expand, add, or remove our Services, features, functionalities, and the support of certain devices and platforms.
V1.onde: Doc 2, seção 'Availability And Termination Of Our Services', subitem 'Availability Of Our Services'
V1.por_que: Nos Termos (vinculante) só há linguagem de 'improve' sem menção a teste — relevante para comparar o nível por registro.

V1.verbatim: We are constantly working to improve our Services and develop new features to make our products even better for you and our community.
V1.onde: Doc 2, seção 'Other', parágrafo sobre atualização dos Termos
V1.por_que: Confirma que os ToS ficam apenas no patamar de 'melhorar', ao contrário da Política de Privacidade.

V2.verbatim: To improve the WhatsApp Service by developing new features or updating existing features, we:
V2.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Legitimate Interests', cabeçalho da linha da tabela
V2.por_que: Enquadramento explícito de service improvement associado diretamente à menção de experimentos.

V2.verbatim: product research and testing (features of) services to help us improve our Services; and
V2.onde: Doc 1, seção 'How We Work With Other Meta Companies'
V2.por_que: Co-ocorrência de 'research' com 'improve our Services' — sustenta marcação dupla (service improvement + research).

V2.verbatim: invite you to take surveys or provide feedback and analyse your responses to gain insights into users’ views (for example, about the Service and Meta Companies).
V2.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Legitimate Interests', linha 'To improve the WhatsApp Service by developing new features or updating existing features'
V2.por_que: Pesquisa com usuários via surveys; avaliador decide se configura 'research' e/ou aproxima de human-subjects research.

V2.verbatim: It is in our interest and in the interest of WhatsApp users to evaluate the use of the services and adoption of new features to inform the development of future features and improve product direction and development.
V2.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Legitimate Interests', coluna 'Legitimate Interests Relied On' da linha de melhoria do serviço
V2.por_que: Justificativa declarada; mistura interesse da empresa e dos usuários, sem linguagem de bem-estar comunitário.

V2.verbatim: In our interest to measure the use of our Services and count the people who interact with the WhatsApp services in order to inform business decisions and to enable provision of accurate and reliable reporting.
V2.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Legitimate Interests', linha 'Business intelligence and analytics'
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de business intelligence/analytics, distinto de bem-estar social; útil para descartar social-good.

V2.verbatim: We are constantly working to improve our Services and develop new features to make our products even better for you and our community.
V2.por_que: Única menção a 'community' nos documentos; avaliador deve julgar se é linguagem de social-good/community ou apenas retórica de melhoria.

V3.verbatim: test out and experiment with new features to see if they work as expected.
V3.onde: Doc 1, tabela 'Processing necessary to perform our contract with you', item 'To generally operate and provide our Services'
V3.por_que: Nomeia a superfície testada ('new features'), sustentando V3a=Yes, mas sem alvo específico (ranking, preço, afeto).

V3.verbatim: undertake experiments to evaluate the impact of new features.
V3.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Legitimate Interests', linha de melhoria do serviço
V3.por_que: Atividade nomeada de forma genérica; não identifica experimento específico ou ativo (V3c).

V3.verbatim: facilitate and provide access to exclusive features when you choose to sign up for subscription features.
V3.onde: Doc 1, tabela de contrato, item 'To generally operate and provide our Services'
V3.por_que: Menção a assinatura/features exclusivas; relevante para verificar se há alvo de preço — aqui não há teste de preço.

V3.verbatim: If you choose to sign up for subscription features , for example, Meta One, Meta receives Device And Connection Information (e.g. an identifier used for your subscription, app version), Usage Information (e.g. which entry point you use for subscriptions), and User Choices (e.g. whether you have added your WhatsApp account to an Accounts Centre and your subscription status) to provide the subscription.
V3.onde: Doc 1, seção 'How We Work With Other Meta Companies', subseção 'Where Meta provides optional experiences through WhatsApp'
V3.por_que: Única referência a assinatura paga; não descreve preço como alvo de experimento — apoia v3_pricing=No.

V3.verbatim: Advertising. We use cookies when you use Status and Channels, which are optional, to help show you ads and measure how they perform. For example, we use a unique user identifier that allows us to display the ad correctly to users.
V3.onde: Doc 3, seção 'How we use cookies', item 'Advertising'

V4.verbatim: To improve the WhatsApp Service by developing new features or updating existing features, we:

V4.por_que: A finalidade que cobre experimentação está listada sob o cabeçalho 'Legitimate Interests', indicando a base legal declarada.

V4.verbatim: We rely on our legitimate interests or the legitimate interests of a third-party, such as our users, where they are not outweighed by your interests or fundamental rights and freedoms ("legitimate interests"):
V4.por_que: Declaração explícita da base legal de interesse legítimo aplicável às finalidades listadas, incluindo melhoria/experimentos.

V4.verbatim: test out and experiment with new features to see if they work as expected.
V4.onde: Doc 1, tabela 'Processing necessary to perform our contract with you'

V4.verbatim: For all users who have the legal capacity to enter into an enforceable contract (for example, by being the age of majority or above in their country of residence), we process information as necessary to conclude and perform our contract with you, our Terms .
V4.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Processing necessary to perform our contract with you'
V4.por_que: Define a base contratual para as finalidades daquela tabela, onde consta 'test out and experiment with new features'.

V4.verbatim: Under applicable data protection law in the European Region (such as the GDPR), companies must have a legal basis to process information. We rely on different legal bases to process your information for the various purposes described in this Privacy Policy.
V4.onde: Doc 1, seção 'How and Why We Process Your Information and Our Legal Basis For Processing'
V4.por_que: Indica que a tabela de bases legais é específica do documento EEA; relevante para v4_region_gated.

V4.verbatim: If you live in the European Region , WhatsApp Ireland Limited (" WhatsApp ," " our ," " we ," or " us ") provides our Services to you under the Terms of Service and this Privacy Policy.
V4.por_que: Confirma que este documento se aplica apenas à Região Europeia (gating regional por residência declarada).

V4.verbatim: Even if you do not choose to use our precise location-related features (see Information Shared by You and by WhatsApp with Third Parties ), we use IP addresses and other information like phone number area codes, to estimate your general location (e.g., country/region).
V4.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Information We Collect', item 'General Location Information'

V4.verbatim: If you live outside the UK or the European Region , WhatsApp LLC provides the Services to you under this Terms of Service and Privacy Policy .
V4.onde: Doc 2, cabeçalho antes de 'About Our Services'
V4.por_que: Evidencia a existência de versões distintas por região, elemento do julgamento de v4_region_gated.

V5.onde: Doc 1, seção 'How To Exercise Your Rights'

V5.verbatim: You have the right to object to, and seek restriction of, this processing. To exercise your rights, visit the How To Exercise Your Rights section of this Privacy Policy.
V5.onde: Doc 1, logo após a tabela de 'Legitimate Interests' (que inclui a linha de experimentos)
V5.por_que: Liga explicitamente o direito de objeção ao conjunto de processamentos por interesse legítimo, que inclui 'undertake experiments'.

V5.verbatim: This includes the right to object to our processing of your information for direct marketing and the right to object to our processing of your information where we are pursuing our legitimate interests or those of a third-party. We will consider several factors when assessing an objection including: your reasonable expectations; the benefits and risks to you, us, other users, third parties; and other available means to achieve the same purpose that may be less invasive and do not require disproportionate effort.
V5.onde: Doc 1, seção 'How To Exercise Your Rights'
V5.por_que: Detalha o escopo e as condições da objeção; nenhum controle dedicado a experimentos é oferecido.

V5.verbatim: We collect information about your in-app settings, privacy settings and records about when you accepted terms. Only you are in control of your privacy settings which can be used to change, for example, who can see your "last seen and online", profile photo, "about" information, Status Updates, read receipts or add you to groups.
V5.onde: Doc 1, seção 'Information We Collect', item 'User Choices'

V5.verbatim: You can follow the instructions provided by your browser or device (usually located under "Settings" or "Preferences") to modify your cookie settings.
V5.por_que: Controle disponível é de cookies (incl. analytics/ads), não de experimentação — falso positivo clássico a ser descartado.

V5.verbatim: You can make choices about the information used to show you ads in your Ads preferences .
V5.por_que: Preferências de anúncios governam publicidade, não experimentos — relevante para distinguir 'cookie/ads-only'.

V7.verbatim: undertake experiments to evaluate the impact of new features.
